svg.text: Cascading operational paralysis across academic, residential, and examination services
Students locked out of online quizzes;
Treats every reported symptom as an isolated ticket with no service graph.
Single human admin manually reads and assigns 1,200+ incoming storm tickets.
Technicians or DBAs can silently alter historical timestamps via raw SQL.
Clocks keep ticking during vendor/client hold or outside working hours.
Critical campus outages drag on for 6.8+ hours with cascading SLA breaches.
Tarjan O(V+E) cycle guard & automatic downstream blast-radius calculation.
Clusters 500+ duplicate natural-language reports into 1 master problem in <3.2ms.
SHA-256 tamper-evident immutable audit ledger with FOR UPDATE locking.
Freezes SLA on WAITING_FOR_CLIENT; enforces sticky breach & business hours.
Skill-Match, Least-Loaded & Hungarian dispatch cuts MTTR to under 42 minutes.
